Contract ManageBankCardCRUDService::createBankCard(cardid: Integer,cardstatus: CardStatus[NORMAL|SUSPEND|CANCEL],catalog: CardCatalog[CREDIT|DEPOSIT],password: Integer,balance: Real): Boolean {
	definition:
		bankCard: BankCard = BankCard.allInstance()->any(o|o.CardID = cardid),
		success: Boolean = if bankCard.oclIsUndefined() 
		then BankCard.allInstance()->exists(o|o.CardID = cardid and
		o.CardStatus = cardstatus and
		o.Catalog = catalog and
		o.Password = password and
		o.Balance = balance) 
		else (bankCard.CardStatus = cardstatus and
		bankCard.Catalog = catalog and
		bankCard.Password = password and
		bankCard.Balance = balance) 
		endif 
	precondition:
		true
	postcondition:
		result = success
}
